column2:
bachelor(n.)單身漢、學士
(無詞性變化)
bachelor's degree 學士學位
eligible bachelor 黃金單身漢
She earned a bachelor's degree in computer science from National Taiwan University.
(她取得了台灣大學資訊工程學士學位。)
My uncle remained a bachelor until he was forty-five.
(我叔叔一直單身到四十五歲。)

backbone(n.)脊椎、骨幹、支柱、骨氣
(無詞性變化)
backbone of the economy 經濟的支柱
have the backbone to 有骨氣去……
Small and medium-sized businesses are the backbone of Taiwan's economy.
(中小企業是台灣經濟的支柱。)
Few people had the backbone to stand up against the unfair decision.
(很少人有勇氣站出來反對這個不公平的決定。)

badge(n.)徽章、名牌、象徵
(無詞性變化)
name badge 名牌
badge of honor 榮譽的象徵
All visitors must wear a name badge while they are in the building.
(所有訪客在大樓內都必須配戴名牌。)
For the young soldier, the scar was a badge of honor rather than shame.
(對那位年輕士兵而言，這道疤痕是榮譽的象徵，而非恥辱。)

banquet(n./v.)宴會、盛宴、宴請
(無詞性變化)
wedding banquet 婚宴
banquet hall 宴會廳
More than three hundred guests attended the wedding banquet at the hotel.
(超過三百位賓客出席了在飯店舉辦的婚宴。)
The company holds a year-end banquet to thank its employees for their hard work.
(公司舉辦尾牙宴，感謝員工一整年的辛勞。)

barbarian(adj./n.)野蠻的、未開化的、野蠻人
barbaric(adj.)野蠻的、殘暴的
barbarism(n.)野蠻、未開化
barbarian invasion 蠻族入侵
barbarian tribes 蠻族部落
The Great Wall was built partly to keep out barbarian invaders from the north.
(長城的建造部分是為了抵禦北方的蠻族入侵者。)
The ancient Romans called people outside their empire barbarians.
(古羅馬人把帝國以外的人稱為蠻族。)

bass(n./adj.)低音、貝斯、低音的
(無詞性變化)
bass guitar 電貝斯
bass voice 男低音
He plays bass guitar in a rock band with his high school friends.
(他和高中朋友組了一個搖滾樂團，擔任貝斯手。)
The singer's deep bass voice filled the whole concert hall.
(那位歌手深沉的低音響徹整個音樂廳。)

batter(n./v.)麵糊、打擊手、連續猛擊
battered(adj.)破舊的、受虐的
pancake batter 鬆餅麵糊
batter down 擊倒、打破
Pour the pancake batter into the hot pan and cook it until golden.
(把鬆餅麵糊倒入熱鍋，煎到呈金黃色。)
Huge waves battered the coast during the powerful typhoon.
(強烈颱風期間，巨浪不斷猛烈拍打海岸。)

beautify(v.)美化、使美麗
beauty(n.)美、美人
beautiful(adj.)美麗的
beautify the city 美化市容
beautify the environment 美化環境
The city government planted thousands of trees to beautify the riverside park.
(市政府種了數千棵樹來美化河濱公園。)
Students painted murals on the walls to beautify their campus.
(學生們在牆上畫壁畫來美化校園。)

beep(n./v.)嗶嗶聲、發出嗶嗶聲
beeper(n.)呼叫器
after the beep 嗶聲之後
beep the horn 按喇叭
Please leave a message after the beep, and I will call you back.
(請在嗶聲後留言，我會回電給你。)
The microwave beeped to let us know the food was ready.
(微波爐嗶嗶作響，告訴我們食物已經好了。)

beforehand(adv.)事先、預先
(無詞性變化)
know beforehand 事先知道
prepare beforehand 事先準備
If you are going to be late, please let me know beforehand.
(如果你會遲到，請事先告訴我。)
The speech went smoothly because she had prepared well beforehand.
(因為她事先做了充分準備，演講進行得很順利。)

beverage(n.)飲料
(無詞性變化)
alcoholic beverage 含酒精飲料
hot beverage 熱飲
Sugary beverages are one of the main causes of tooth decay among teenagers.
(含糖飲料是青少年蛀牙的主要原因之一。)
The sale of alcoholic beverages to people under eighteen is prohibited.
(禁止販售含酒精飲料給未滿十八歲的人。)

bilateral(adj.)雙邊的、雙方的、兩側的
(無詞性變化)
bilateral trade 雙邊貿易
bilateral agreement 雙邊協定
The two countries signed a bilateral agreement to promote cultural exchange.
(兩國簽署了一項促進文化交流的雙邊協定。)
Bilateral trade between Taiwan and Japan has grown steadily in recent years.
(台日之間的雙邊貿易近年來穩定成長。)

blaze(n./v.)火焰、大火、熊熊燃燒、閃耀
blazing(adj.)熾熱的、燃燒的
blaze of glory 光榮的時刻
blazing sun 烈日
Firefighters struggled for hours to put out the blaze in the factory.
(消防員奮戰了好幾個小時才撲滅工廠的大火。)
The farmers kept working under the blazing summer sun.
(農夫們在炎炎夏日下持續工作。)

bleach(n./v.)漂白劑、漂白
(無詞性變化)
bleach one's hair 漂髮
household bleach 家用漂白水
She bleached her hair blonde during summer vacation.
(她在暑假期間把頭髮漂成金色。)
Never mix household bleach with other cleaning products, because it can produce toxic gas.
(絕對不要把家用漂白水和其他清潔劑混合，因為可能會產生有毒氣體。)

blond(n./adj.)金髮的、金髮的人
blonde(n./adj.)金髮的、金髮女子
blond hair 金髮
blue-eyed blonde 碧眼金髮女子
The little boy with curly blond hair is my cousin from Australia.
(那個有一頭金色捲髮的小男孩是我來自澳洲的表弟。)
The actress dyed her hair blonde for her new movie role.
(那位女演員為了新電影角色把頭髮染成金色。)

blot(v./n.)弄髒、吸乾、汙漬、汙點
(無詞性變化)
ink blot 墨漬
blot out 遮蔽、抹去
The scandal was a blot on the politician's otherwise clean record.
(這起醜聞是那位政治人物原本清白紀錄上的一個汙點。)
Thick clouds blotted out the sun for most of the afternoon.
(厚厚的雲層在下午大部分時間都遮蔽了太陽。)

blunt(adj./v.)鈍的、直率的、使變鈍
bluntly(adv.)直率地、坦白地
blunt knife 鈍刀
to put it bluntly 坦白說
This knife is too blunt to cut the tomatoes properly.
(這把刀太鈍了，切不好番茄。)
To put it bluntly, your essay needs a lot more work before you hand it in.
(坦白說，你的作文在繳交之前還需要大幅修改。)

bodily(adj./adv.)身體的、肉體的、整個地
body(n.)身體
bodily harm 身體傷害
bodily functions 身體機能
The law protects citizens from threats of bodily harm.
(法律保護公民免受身體傷害的威脅。)
Water is essential for maintaining normal bodily functions.
(水對維持正常的身體機能至關重要。)

booklet(n.)小冊子
book(n./v.)書、預訂
information booklet 資訊手冊
test booklet 試題本
Each new student received an information booklet about school rules.
(每位新生都收到一本有關校規的資訊手冊。)
Please write your answers on the answer sheet, not in the test booklet.
(請將答案寫在答案卡上，不要寫在試題本裡。)

bosom(n.)胸懷、內心、胸部
(無詞性變化)
bosom friend 知己、密友
in the bosom of one's family 在家人的懷抱中
The two girls have been bosom friends since elementary school.
(這兩個女孩從小學開始就是知心好友。)
After years abroad, he was happy to be back in the bosom of his family.
(在國外多年後，他很高興能回到家人的懷抱。)

boulevard(n.)林蔭大道、大街
(無詞性變化)
tree-lined boulevard 綠樹成蔭的大道
broad boulevard 寬闊的大道
We strolled along the tree-lined boulevard on a quiet Sunday morning.
(在一個寧靜的週日早晨，我們沿著綠樹成蔭的大道散步。)
Many famous shops and cafés line the wide boulevard in Paris.
(巴黎那條寬闊的林蔭大道兩旁有許多知名商店和咖啡館。)

boxing(n.)拳擊
box(v./n.)拳擊、盒子
boxer(n.)拳擊手
boxing match 拳擊比賽
boxing gloves 拳擊手套
He took up boxing to stay fit and relieve stress after work.
(他開始練拳擊，以保持身材並紓解下班後的壓力。)
Thousands of fans watched the boxing match on live TV.
(數千名粉絲透過電視直播觀看了那場拳擊賽。)

boycott(n./v.)聯合抵制、杯葛
(無詞性變化)
call for a boycott 呼籲抵制
consumer boycott 消費者抵制
Consumers called for a boycott of the brand after the food safety scandal.
(食安醜聞發生後，消費者呼籲抵制該品牌。)
Several countries boycotted the Olympic Games for political reasons.
(有幾個國家因政治因素杯葛奧運會。)

brace(n./v.)支架、牙套、使做好準備
bracing(adj.)令人振奮的、清新的
brace oneself for 做好……的準備
wear braces 戴牙套
Residents were told to brace themselves for the strong typhoon.
(居民被告知要為強烈颱風做好準備。)
My sister has to wear braces on her teeth for two years.
(我妹妹必須戴兩年牙套。)

brassiere(n.)胸罩、內衣
bra(n.)胸罩(口語)
sports bra 運動內衣
bra size 胸罩尺寸
Female runners usually wear a sports bra for comfort and support.
(女性跑者通常會穿運動內衣以求舒適和支撐。)
The word brassiere is rarely used today; most people simply say bra.
(brassiere 這個字現在很少用，多數人只說 bra。)

breadth(n.)寬度、廣度
broad(adj.)寬的、廣泛的
broaden(v.)加寬、拓寬
breadth of knowledge 知識的廣度
length and breadth 長和寬、全境
The professor impressed us with the breadth of his knowledge.
(那位教授知識之廣博令我們印象深刻。)
They traveled the length and breadth of Taiwan on their bicycles.
(他們騎腳踏車走遍了台灣各地。)

breakdown(n.)故障、崩潰、細目分析
break down(v.)故障、崩潰、分解
nervous breakdown 精神崩潰
breakdown of ……的破裂、分析
Our car had a breakdown on the highway, so we had to call for help.
(我們的車在高速公路上拋錨，所以只好求救。)
The report includes a detailed breakdown of how the money was spent.
(這份報告包含了經費使用的詳細分析。)

breakup(n.)分手、解散、瓦解
break up(v.)分手、解散
painful breakup 痛苦的分手
breakup of the band 樂團解散
After a painful breakup, she decided to focus on her studies.
(經歷一段痛苦的分手後，她決定專心念書。)
Fans were shocked by the sudden breakup of the popular band.
(那個受歡迎的樂團突然解散，讓歌迷們十分震驚。)

bribe(n./v.)賄賂、賄款
bribery(n.)行賄、受賄
accept a bribe 收賄
bribe someone into 收買某人做……
The official was arrested for accepting bribes from a construction company.
(那名官員因收受營建公司的賄賂而被捕。)
The mother tried to bribe her son into doing homework with ice cream.
(那位媽媽試圖用冰淇淋收買兒子去寫功課。)

brink(n.)邊緣、初始
(無詞性變化)
on the brink of 瀕臨……
brink of extinction 瀕臨絕種
Many species of frogs are on the brink of extinction because of habitat loss.
(許多種青蛙因棲地消失而瀕臨絕種。)
The two countries were on the brink of war before the talks began.
(談判開始前，兩國已處於戰爭邊緣。)

broaden(v.)擴大、拓寬
broad(adj.)寬的、廣泛的
breadth(n.)寬度、廣度
broaden one's horizons 開拓視野
broaden the road 拓寬道路
Studying abroad can greatly broaden your horizons.
(出國留學能大幅開拓你的視野。)
The city plans to broaden the road to reduce traffic jams.
(市政府計劃拓寬道路以減少交通壅塞。)

brochure(n.)小冊子、宣傳手冊
(無詞性變化)
travel brochure 旅遊手冊
free brochure 免費手冊
The travel agent gave us a brochure with information about tours to Europe.
(旅行社業務給了我們一本介紹歐洲行程的手冊。)
You can pick up a free brochure about the museum at the front desk.
(你可以在服務台索取免費的博物館簡介手冊。)

broil(v.)燒烤、炙烤、酷熱
broiler(n.)烤架、烤箱、肉雞
broiled fish 烤魚
broil the steak 烤牛排
My father broiled the salmon with lemon and salt for dinner.
(我爸爸晚餐用檸檬和鹽炙烤鮭魚。)
Broiled chicken is a healthier choice than fried chicken.
(烤雞比炸雞是更健康的選擇。)

brook(n.)小溪、小河
(無詞性變化)
babbling brook 潺潺小溪
mountain brook 山澗
We sat by the babbling brook and listened to the birds singing.
(我們坐在潺潺的小溪旁，聆聽鳥兒歌唱。)
The children caught small fish in the clear mountain brook.
(孩子們在清澈的山澗裡抓小魚。)

broth(n.)清湯、肉湯
(無詞性變化)
chicken broth 雞湯
beef broth 牛肉高湯
When I had a cold, my grandmother made me a bowl of warm chicken broth.
(我感冒時，奶奶替我煮了一碗溫熱的雞湯。)
The secret of good beef noodles lies in the rich broth.
(好吃牛肉麵的祕訣在於濃郁的湯頭。)

brotherhood(n.)兄弟情誼、手足之情、同業團體
brother(n.)兄弟
brotherly(adj.)兄弟般的
sense of brotherhood 兄弟情誼
universal brotherhood 四海之內皆兄弟
Playing on the same team gave the players a strong sense of brotherhood.
(在同一支隊伍打球讓球員們產生了深厚的兄弟情誼。)
The festival celebrates peace and the brotherhood of all people.
(這個節慶歌頌和平與四海一家的情誼。)

bulky(adj.)龐大的、笨重的
bulk(n.)大量、大部分、體積
bulky item 大型物品
bulky furniture 笨重的家具
Bulky items such as sofas cannot be thrown away with regular garbage.
(沙發等大型物品不能和一般垃圾一起丟棄。)
The winter jacket is warm but too bulky to pack in a small suitcase.
(這件冬季外套很保暖，但太笨重，放不進小行李箱。)

bureaucrat(n.)官僚、公務員
bureaucracy(n.)官僚體制
bureaucratic(adj.)官僚的
senior bureaucrat 高階官員
faceless bureaucrat 無名小官僚
Some people complain that decisions are made by bureaucrats who don't understand local needs.
(有些人抱怨決策是由不了解地方需求的官僚所制定的。)
A senior bureaucrat from the ministry explained the new policy to the press.
(部會的一名高階官員向媒體說明新政策。)

bypass(n./v.)繞道、旁路、繞過、規避
(無詞性變化)
heart bypass 心臟繞道手術
bypass the city center 繞過市中心
The new highway allows drivers to bypass the crowded city center.
(新的公路讓駕駛人可以繞過擁擠的市中心。)
Some students tried to bypass the school's Internet filter.
(有些學生試圖規避學校的網路過濾系統。)
